market: Europe Polyolefin Hot Melt Adhesives Market
market_definition: The polyolefin hot melt adhesives market comprises thermoplastic adhesives based on amorphous polyalpha-olefins, polypropylene or polyethylene polymers. It measures sales of finished hot melts valued for low odour, thermal stability and adhesion to low-energy surfaces. BY POLYMER BASE: Amorphous Poly-Alpha-Olefin (APAO), Metallocene Polyolefin, Polyethylene-Based, Polypropylene-Based. BY OPEN TIME: Short, Medium, Long. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Hygiene & Nonwovens, Packaging & Converting, Automotive Interiors, Woodworking, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: EVA, polyamide, polyester and SBC hot melts; hot melt glue sticks; reactive PUR hot melts; polyolefin foams. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms. GEOGRAPHY OF THIS LIST: EUROPE - companies headquartered in a European country (EU, United Kingdom, EFTA, Western Balkans, Ukraine, Moldova, Russia).
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
